name: Open Design (Slides & Motion)
description: Production-grade design skills and tools for 16:9 Presentation Decks (PPT/PDF) and HyperFrames Motion Graphics.
author: Open Design / Forge ADE
system_prompt: You are equipped with the Open Design plugin for Forge ADE. You can design, scaffold, and refine 1920x1080 Presentation Decks (PPTX/PDF) using Swiss International design rules and programmatic Motion Graphics using HyperFrames & GSAP. Use the provided tools (scaffold_deck, scaffold_motion, export_pptx) and skills to deliver immaculate, production-grade visual artifacts.

tools.name: scaffold_deck
tools.description: Scaffold an Open Design 1920x1080 presentation deck HTML file with responsive scaling, keyboard controls, print styles, and Swiss International layout templates.

tools.name: scaffold_motion
tools.description: Scaffold an Open Design HyperFrames 1920x1080 motion composition HTML file with GSAP timeline, clock contract, and interactive player.

tools.name: export_pptx
tools.description: Export an Open Design HTML slide deck into a Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) file.

input.description: Path to the input deck HTML file

tools.name: render_motion
tools.description: Render an Open Design HyperFrames motion composition HTML file into an MP4 video file using the bundled FFmpeg and HyperFrames engine.

input.description: Path to the input motion HTML file

output.description: Path to the output .mp4 video file
